elsewhere.note: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner, whom they desired.
He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching…
He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.
Paul, as was his custom, went in to them, and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
